description: Public Service Commission - Amendment to the notice related to the Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1941/41 of 20.11.2015 and comes into effect from 11.02.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically deals with the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding public service matters, including transfers, disciplinary control, appointments, and promotions of public officers. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector administration, service conditions, and administrative instructions related to government employees.
